newsitem.title: UK: Energy minister to lead U.K. trade mission to Asia.
newsitem.headline: Energy minister to lead U.K. trade mission to Asia.

text.p: Officials from 25 British oil, gas and petrochemical supply and service companies will accompany Energy Minister Lord Fraser of Carmyllie next week on a trade mission to Malaysia and Singapore.

"Malaysia and Singapore hold key positions in the region and are vital to its future development. The companies accompanying me on this mission have extensive expertise...and we believe are best placed to benefit from the opportunities in the dynamic South East Asia market," Lord Fraser said on Friday.

Lord Fraser, who arrives in Malaysia on September 17, will meet with Malaysian Oil and Gas Minister Datuk Abang Abu Bakar Abang Mustapha and Goh Chee Wee, a minister in the Ministry of Trade and Industry of Singapore. He returns home on September 23. --London newsroom, +44 171 542 6280
